notes.title: Moving of the Nun take 2
notes.content: Zeus, our little ferret, decided to pop in and add an alternative for those saved just before the nun. That way you won't have to restart if you don't want to. He is off to the right near the waterside enjoying his own reflection until you talk to him. Don't do so unless your save is older than 8/29/2020 at 7:00 PM

notes.title: The Nun blocks Tyra from escaping!
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the nun in the start of the game would block the player from leaving town of the player was out of order in a few events.

notes.title: Elemental Echoes Small Fix
notes.content: Fixed Quest giver to register variables in the questline such as the appearance of the Priestess and act accordingly.

notes.title: Elemental Echoes Minor Patch
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where you would grab Rin as a party member but still be blocked from the pyramid. 

Fixed an issue some users had with the games exe file.

notes.title: Elemental Echoes Update!
notes.content:
Fixed Audio Issue where Pyramid Boss room would not load proper audio file.

Updated some of the minor audio of some cutscenes thus fixing an issue where two background music pieces overlapped when introduced to Tyra.

Fixed some dialogue spelling between Tyra and future party member.
